# volcenginecc_iam_api_key (Resource)

IAM API Key。

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcenginecc_iam_api_key" "example" {
  user_name            = "user-xxxx"
  name                 = "ccapi-apikey-full"
  permissions_boundary = "{\"Statement\":[{\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Action\":[\"iam:*\"],\"Resource\":[\"*\"]}]}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) API Key Name
- `user_name` (String) Username

### Optional

- `permissions_boundary` (String) Permission Boundary
- `status` (String) API Key Status

### Read-Only

- `api_key_id` (String) API Key ID。
- `create_date` (String) Created At
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `secret` (String) API Key Secret
- `update_date` (String) Last Updated

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import volcenginecc_iam_api_key.example "user_name|api_key_id"
```
